experiments.scope: Birthday collision search on 16-bit truncation of SHA-256-r39. Demonstrates that the iterated hash function exhibits random-function-like collision structure at reduced width, supporting extrapolation to full 256-bit width.
experiments.hypothesis: The birthday collision search finds partial collisions (matching low 16 bits) on SHA-256-r39 at the expected birthday rate, confirming random-function-like behavior of the iteration function.
